rationale:

Its `description` meets the MUST. It begins "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing, or when `cargo test` or `habeas status` reports Habeas findings…". It then adds the user's likely phrasing, "the habeas test is failing". That states when to use the skill in terms of the user's task.

The description also says "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement MAY name another bundled skill where the two could be confused. `assets/skills/habeas-refactor` exists, so this is a permitted reference to a real bundled skill. This is the only optional element in the description, and nothing in it is forbidden.

The requirement lists no violation queries for this site. I found no gap.
